title: Apply a new child and its ancestor's relation change from the same task-sync folder in one import instead of holding the child as ancestor_binding
outcome: Apply a new child and its ancestor's relation change from the same task-sync folder in one import instead of holding the child as ancestor_binding
acceptance: An import whose folder carries both an ancestor's relation change and a new descendant under it applies the ancestor change first and then the descendant in the same import, when both are admissible, with no ancestor_binding hold and no second import needed
Holds for genuinely blocked cases (engaged execution, a refused ancestor change) are unchanged and still name ancestor_binding with their reason
docs/features/task-folder-relations.md and task-planning-text.md describe the single-import behaviour in place of 'held for a later fresh import'
